64938.commentary: (SNa) semānan'ti uttānaṃ hutvā sayitaṃ hoti. (JAa) api passena semāno'ti ekena passena sayamānako'pi.

64939.meaning1: crawling on the belly; leopard crawling
64939.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, yasmā idāni yadi'pi me idaṃ sarīraṃ gām'ante ṭhitaṃ, ajjhāsayo pana araññam'eva gato, tasmā semānako'pi gacchāmi gelaññena ṭhānanisajjāgamanesu asamatthatāya sayāno'pi iminā sayitākārena sarīsapo viya sarīsapanto, etha, bhante, araññam'eva gacchāma

examples.text: upajjhāyo maṃ avaca, ito gacchāma sīvaka, gāme me vasati kāyo, araññaṃ me gato mano, semānako'pi gacchāmi, n'atthi saṅgo vijānatan'ti.

64940.commentary: (KPa) tato paraṃ sarīr'abbhantare ekapattapūrappamāṇaṃ semhaṃ vaṇṇato setaṃ kacchakapaṇṇarasavaṇṇan'ti vavatthapeti. saṇṭhānato okāsasaṇṭhānaṃ. disato uparimāya disāya jātaṃ. okāsato udarapaṭale ṭhitanti. yaṃ pānabhojan'ādi-ajjhoharaṇakāle seyyathā'pi nāma udake sevālapaṇakaṃ kaṭṭhe vā kathale vā patante chijjitvā dvidhā hutvā puna ajjhottharitvā tiṭṭhati, evam'eva pānabhojan'ādimhi nipatante chijjitvā dvidhā hutvā puna ajjhottharitvā tiṭṭhati, yamhi ca mandībhūte pakkamiva gaṇḍaṃ pūtikam'iva kukkuṭ'aṇḍaṃ udarapaṭalaṃ paramajegucchakuṇapagandhaṃ hoti. tato uggatena ca gandhena uggāro'pi mukham'pi duggandhaṃ pūtikuṇapasadisaṃ hoti, so ca puriso apehi duggandhaṃ vāyasī'ti vattabbataṃ āpajjati, yañ'ca abhivaḍḍhitaṃ bahalattam'āpannaṃ paṭikujjanaphalakam'iva vaccakuṭiyā udarapaṭal'abbhantare eva kuṇapagandhaṃ sannirumbhitvā tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane. katame pañca? acakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonandhati, bhattam'assa nacchādeti.
pittaṃ semhañ'ca vāto ca, sannipātā utūni ca, visamaṃ opakkamikaṃ, kammavipākena aṭṭhamī'ti.

64941.meaning1: enveloped with a membrane of mucus

examples.text: evam'eva taṃdivasam'pi hiyyo'pi tato purime divase'pi ajjhohato sabbo ekato hutvā semhapaṭala-pariyonaddho kāy'aggi-santāpa-kuthita-kuthana-sañjāta-pheṇapupphuḷakācito paramajegucchabhāvaṃ upagantvā tiṭṭhatī'ti evaṃ aparipakkato paṭikkūlatā paccavekkhitabbā.

64942.meaning1: based on phlegm; due to mucus
64942.commentary: (NIDD1a) pittasamuṭṭhānā'ti pittena samuṭṭhānaṃ uppatti etesan'ti pittasamuṭṭhānā. te kira dvattiṃsa honti. semhasamuṭṭhān'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā vātasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā sannipātikā ābādhā utupariṇāmajā ābādhā visamaparihārajā ābādhā opakkamikā ābādhā kammavipākajā ābādhā sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo'ti.
na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ kaṇḍaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, yassa nhārunā parikkhittaṃ yadi vā gavassa yadi vā mahiṃsassa yadi vā bheravassa yadi vā semhārassā'ti

tasmā yassa pitt'āsayo adhiko hoti, tassa bahalamadhukatelamakkhito viya paramajeguccho hoti. yassa semh'āsayo adhiko hoti, tassa nāgabalapaṇṇarasamakkhito viya. yassa pubb'āsayo adhiko hoti, tassa pūtitakkamakkhito viya.

64946.commentary: (SNa) madhupītā'va seyare'ti gandhamadhupānaṃ pītā viya sayanti. gandhamadhupānaṃ pīto kira sīsaṃ ukkhipituṃ na sakkoti, asaññī hutvā sayat'eva. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: kiṃ me katā rājagahe manussā, madhupītā'va seyare, ye sukkaṃ na payirupāsanti, desentiṃ amataṃ padaṃ.
tasmā hi paññā'va dhanena seyyā, yāya vosānam'idh'ādhigacchati, abyositattā hi bhav'ābhavesu, pāpāni kammāni karoti mohā.
itthī'pi hi ekacciyā, seyyā posa janādhipa, medhāvinī sīlavatī, sassudevā patibbatā.
evaṃ naraṃ annapānavatthadadaṃ, seyyāni paccattharaṇassa dāyakaṃ, puññassa dhārā upayanti paṇḍitaṃ, najjo yathā vārivahā'va sāgaran'ti.
udar'āvadehakaṃ bhutvā, sayant'uttānaseyyakā. kathaṃ vattenti paṭibuddhā, yā kathā satthugarahitā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako hatthena vā pādena vā aṅgāraṃ akkamitvā khippam'eva paṭisaṃharati.

64952.meaning1: just like; as if; imagine if

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ
seyyathā'pi, cunda, visamo maggo assa, tassa añño samo maggo parikkamanāya, seyyathā vā pana, cunda, visamaṃ titthaṃ assa, tassa aññaṃ samaṃ titthaṃ parikkamanāya.

64953.meaning1: just like; as if; imagine if; suppose

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggam'akkhāyati.
iti'ss'ime tayo dhammā sammādiṭṭhiṃ anuparidhāvanti anuparivattanti, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati.
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo, seyyath'īdaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho vedan'ūpādānakkhandho saññ'ūpādānakkhandho saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ, sake muttakarīse palipannaṃ seyyamānaṃ, aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ, aññehi saṃvesiyamānaṃ.

64957.meaning1: name of a monk infamous for Saṅghādisesa 1

64962.meaning1: makes one's bed; lies down to sleep; sleeps
64962.commentary: (THa) seyyaṃ kappetī'ti arahattappattisamanantaraṃ sayitattā vuttaṃ. thero hi bahu'd'eva rattiṃ caṅkamena vītināmetvā sarīraṃ utuṃ gāhāpetuṃ ovarakaṃ pavisitvā sayituṃ mañcake nisinno pādā ca bhūmito muttā, appattañ'ca sīsaṃ bimbohanaṃ, etth'antare arahattaṃ patvā sayi.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
bahussuto cittakathī, buddhassa paricārako, pannabhāro visaññutto, seyyaṃ kappeti gotamo.

examples.text: seyyaṃ kappeyyā'ti mañcassa vā pīṭhassa vā pavisantassa vā nikkhamantassa vā upacāre seyyaṃ santharati vā santharāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa. abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

64964.grammar: idiom, fem + abs, abs of seyyaṃ santharati
64964.meaning1: having laid out a sleeping place; having made a bed
64964.commentary: (VIN 2.5.2.5) seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre seyyaṃ santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.

n'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, uccākulīnatā seyy'aṃso'ti vadāmi, na pan'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, uccākulīnatā pāpiy'aṃso'ti vadāmi, n'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, uḷāravaṇṇatā seyy'aṃso'ti vadāmi, na pan'āhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, uḷāravaṇṇatā pāpiy'aṃso'ti vadāmi
petaseyyā, kāmabhogiseyyā, sīhaseyyā, tathāgataseyyā. katamā ca, bhikkhave, petaseyyā? yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, petā uttānā senti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, petaseyyā.

64967.commentary: (VIN 2.5.2.5) seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro. (ANa) seyyā'ti mañcapallaṅk'ādisayanaṃ.

examples.text: so ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavh'ābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khañjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyā-āvasatha-padīpeyyassa.
bhavissanti, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ licchavī sukhumālā mudutalunahatthapādā te mudukāsu seyyāsu tūlabimbohanāsu yāvasūriy'uggamanā seyyaṃ kappissanti.
antar'ārāmaṃ gacchati, bhikkhun'upassayaṃ gacchati, titthiyaseyyaṃ gacchati, paṭikkamanaṃ gacchati, bhattiyagharaṃ gacchati, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

64970.compound: dvanda (seyyā ca nisajjā ca attharaṇa ca)

examples.text: evaṃ naraṃ annada-pānavatthadaṃ, seyyā-nisajj'attharaṇassa dāyakaṃ, puññassa dhārā upayanti paṇḍitaṃ, najjo yathā vārivahā'va sāgaran'ti.

64972.compound: dvanda (seyyā ca āvasatha ca padīpeyya ca)

examples.text: sā na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyy'āvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
so ca hoti abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato, lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.

64973.grammar: ind, compar, nom sg of seyya (+abl)

examples.text: nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
seyyo na tena maññeyya, nīceyyo athavā'pi sarikkho, phuṭṭho anekarūpehi, n'ātumānaṃ vikappayaṃ tiṭṭhe.

64974.meaning1: one becomes better; one develops; things get better; there is improvement

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo'ti.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.

64975.meaning1: I am better (because of); I am superior (due to)

examples.text: ye hi keci, soṇa, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, kim'aññatra yathābhūtassa adassanā?

64977.meaning1: I am better; I am superior
64977.commentary: (SNa) seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā'ti aham'asmi seyyo'ti evaṃ mānakoṭṭhāso mānaṭhapanā vā.

examples.text: tisso vidhā, seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā.

64983.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of serivihāra

examples.text: kiṃ pan'imass'āyasmato āraññikassa ekass'āraññe serivihārena, yo ayam'āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu agāravo hoti appatisso'ti, tassa bhavanti vattāro.

64984.meaning1: independent; free; autonomous; going according to pleasure
64984.construction:
sa + √īr + a + ī
sa + īra + ī
64984.commentary: (THa) seri sayaṃvasī ramati (MNa) serī'ti paṭhamaṃ vejjadutiyako pacchā serī ekako bhaveyya.

examples.text: migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvus'ābbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parābhavissasi.
tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma kuṭṭhehi parimucceyya, arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṃ gamo.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho serī devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi

64986.meaning1: made of sirīsa wood; (comm) name of a mansion
64986.commentary: (DNa) suññaṃ serīsakan'ti serīsakaṃ nāma ekaṃ tucchaṃ rajatavimānaṃ upagato. tassa kira dvāre mahāsirīsarukkho, tena taṃ serīsakan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: atha kho pāyāsi rājañño asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ datvā asahatthā dānaṃ datvā acittīkataṃ dānaṃ datvā apaviddhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajji suññaṃ serīsakaṃ vimānaṃ.

64987.commentary: (DNa) atho serīsako sahā'ti tehi saha añño serīsako nāma.

examples.text: gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya
asubh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ, saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃ'va pabbataṃ.
selo yathā ekaghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ nindāpasaṃsāsu, na samiñjanti paṇḍitā.
sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.
idh'ūragānaṃ pavaro paviṭṭho, selassa vaṇṇena pamokkham'icchaṃ, brahmañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ apacāyamāno, bubhukkhito no visahāmi bhottuṃ.

64994.meaning1: name of a Brahman teacher; name of an arahant monk
64994.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk
64994.notes: Theragāthā verses 818-841 (TH16.6, TH253) are attributed to him.

examples.text: aññataro kho pan'āyasmā selo sapariso arahataṃ ahosi.
sā harit'antaṃ vā panth'antaṃ vā sel'antaṃ vā udak'antaṃ vā ramaṇīyaṃ vā bhūmibhāgaṃ āgamma anāhārā nibbāyati. hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ kukkuṭapattena'pi nhārudaddulena'pi aggiṃ gavesanti.

64998.meaning1: attacking a rock; assaulting a stone
64998.commentary: (SNPa) te dāni mayaṃ assādaṃ alabhamānā kāko'va selam'āsajja nibbijj'āpema gotamaṃ āsajja tato gotamā nibbijja apemā'ti.

examples.text: aladdhā tattha assādaṃ, vāyas'etto apakkame, kāko'va selam'āsajja, nibbijj'āpema gotamā'ti.
